data.title: At least 37 dead after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv
data.description: KYIV - At least 37 people have died after a Russian drone struck a depot near Kyiv’s western suburbs overnight, sparking a huge fire and explosions, authorities said on Saturday.

data.title: At least 27 dead after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv
data.description: KYIV - At least 27 people have died after a Russian drone struck a depot near Kyiv’s western suburbs overnight, sparking a huge fire and explosions, authorities said on Saturday.

data.title: Iceland votes on whether to resume EU membership talks
data.description: REYKJAVIK - Icelanders began voting on Saturday in a referendum on whether to resume membership negotiations with the European Union, in a tight race that will be closely watched in Brussels.

data.title: Niger military repels coup attempt
data.description: Niger’s national television station went off air on Saturday after a night of heavy gunfire in parts of the capital Niamey, including around a military base near the city’s airport which has been attacked twice this year by jihadists.

data.title: Cambodia says no online scam compounds remain
data.description: ​The Cambodian government has claimed a milestone ‌in its fight against the scam industry accused of stealing billions of dollars from victims around the world, with officials saying they have eradicated all scam compounds in the country.

data.title: Norway, in mourning, enters new era under Haakon VIII
data.description: OSLO - Norway opened a new chapter in its history on Saturday under King Haakon VIII, after the death of his father Harald, a unifying figure who was on the throne for 35 years.

data.title: Driven by distraction? Trump steps up stunts as US polls loom
data.description: WASHINGTON - From trolling Canada about a lake to suddenly talking about Kim Jong Un, US President Donald Trump's recent distractions speak louder than words.

data.title: The missing in Nepal-Tibet flash floods
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Nearly 2,500 people were still missing Saturday and around 600 confirmed dead after flash floods and landslides hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

data.title: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars past 2,400
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages.

data.title: Leaders of Russia, China, Iran to attend summit in Kyrgyzstan
data.description: BISHKEK (KYRGYZSTAN) - Russia's Vladimir Putin and China's Xi Jinping are expected in Central Asia's Kyrgyzstan Monday for a two-day summit, also attended by Iran's and India's leaders, of a regional bloc seeking to be a counter-influence to the West.

data.title: The chaotic saga of Kanye West's planned Russian concerts
data.description: MOSCOW - From the announcement of his concerts last week to a venue backing out days later, US rap star Kanye West's two planned shows in Russia have captivated the country, with officials divided about whether they should go ahead.

data.title: Driven by distraction? Trump steps up stunts as US midterms loom
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - From trolling Canada about a lake to suddenly talking about Kim Jong Un, US President Donald Trump's recent distractions speak louder than words.

data.title: Greenland to open truth commission over forced contraception scheme
data.description: COPENHAGEN - Greenland said Friday it would establish a Truth and Reconciliation Commission on Denmark's forced contraception of thousands of indigenous Inuits, after experts failed to agree on whether the scheme constituted "genocide".

data.title: The missing in Nepal-Tibet flash floods
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - More than 2,400 people were still missing Friday missing and 584 were confirmed dead after flash floods and landslides hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

data.title: Thieves buy tickets before robbing Vienna museum
data.description: VIENNA - Two men bought tickets to enter Vienna’s Museum of Applied Arts (MAK) before smashing a display case, grabbing a 200-carat platinum and diamond necklace and walking away, police said on Friday.

data.title: Nepal flood trauma ‘enormous’, says Red Cross
data.description: GENEVA - The Nepal-Tibet flood disaster has left an “enormous” level of trauma, the Red Cross said Friday, with early estimates suggesting 93,000 people may have been affected.

data.title: ‘We ran for our lives’: Harrowing tales from Nepal
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Some survivors of the deadly floods on the Nepal-China border ran for their lives, others narrowly missed disaster, but all were eyewitnesses to a major calamity and its aftermath.

data.title: Swiss nuclear plant back online after heatwaves
data.description: GENEVA - The Beznau nuclear power plant in Switzerland, which was shut down multiple times over the last two months due to summer heatwaves, is fully operational again, the Swiss energy company Axpo said on Friday.

data.title: Body found in aircraft wheel well in Kuala Lumpur
data.description: The body of an unidentified person has been discovered in the wheel well of an aircraft at Kuala Lumpur International Airport Terminal 2 (KLIA2), Malaysian authorities said.

data.title: Iran says it’s still open to diplomacy
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran left the door open to diplomacy on Friday, six months into a war with the United States that has upended the Middle East, but only if Washington abandons its pressure campaign.
